name: Brass Rebellion
short_description: In this action-arcade FPS game, destroy waves of automaton enemies through the use of traps in your environment.

name: Thirty Years War
short_description: Fight on the battlefields of early 17th-century Europe in a tactical wargame of religious war, dynastic ambition, and emerging modern armies. Command Imperial, Catholic League, Swedish, Protestant, French, Spanish, Bavarian, and more across 80 scenarios and 2 campaigns spanning the Thirty Years War.

name: Sealed
short_description: A black-site facility has lost containment. The abominations inside are awake and hunting, and you're the last one out. Eliminate every hostile, break the lockdown, and reach extraction. Deal with them, or get dealt with.

name: Hide & Seek
short_description: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.
